page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.medium is an entry-level compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 2 physical cores with 1 thread per core, 4.0 GB of system memory providing 2.0 GB per core, and no local storage or bundled GPU resources. The processor supports AVX and AVX512F instruction sets, alongside AES cryptography and BMI2 integer manipulation.

Benchmark evaluations place this instance in the lower tiers of performance. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is weak, falling into the bottom 25%, while multi-core performance drops to the bottom 10% with a score of 1455.38. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with read-only large block operations registering at 10.27 GB/sec and write operations at 9.34 GB/sec, both in the bottom 10%. These metrics indicate significant performance tradeoffs under sustained or multi-threaded workloads, as reflected in the low Geekbench multi-core score of 1064.0 and Passmark database operations score of 544.12.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation but limited memory and baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps, this instance is structured for low-demand, utility-scale workloads. It is suitable for basic static web serving, which registers a throughput of 1.25 GB/sec, or lightweight Redis operations at 1.42 million operations per second. The lack of local storage and low resource density make it a cost-efficient option for development environments, small-scale testing, or simple background tasks that do not require high memory or storage throughput.
